## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in the master skill.

## Scope

- [ ] Updated the master `SKILL.md`
- [ ] Updated one or more internal references
- [ ] Updated adapters or installation documentation
- [ ] Updated changelog

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] Skill helper tests
- [ ] Repository tooling tests
- [ ] Package ZIP generated and inspected

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No real secrets, `.env` files or personal data added
- [ ] Relative references remain valid
- [ ] No duplicate independent skill was introduced
- [ ] Platform compatibility claims are evidence-based
